The Reichstag ( / ˈ r aɪ ʃ s t æ ɡ , ˈ r aɪ x s t ɑː ɡ / ; [ 2 ] German: [ˈraɪçsˌtaːk] ⓘ ) [ note 1 ] is a historic legislative government building on Platz der Republik in Berlin that is the seat of the German Bundestag . It is also the meeting place of the Federal Convention , which elects the president of Germany .
